page_title: RMA 2-0 GET | Real Madrid v Getafe 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
90+3' The referee blows his whistle, Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
89' That will be all from Alvaro Rodriguez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Peter Federico (Getafe).
86' Chance! Luis Milla (Getafe) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
84' John Joe Patrick Finn (Getafe) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the crossbar.
81' It seemed like Luis Milla (Getafe) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
78' Now Getafe have a corner.
78' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Juan Berrocal Gonzalez is replaced by Yellu Santiago (Getafe).
77' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but David Soria pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
77' The resulting set piece from Real Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
75' Diego Rico (Getafe) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
74' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) skips around David Soria and has the goal at his mercy but unbelievably misses the empty net. Hold your head in shame son!
73' The main referee, Alejandro Hernandez, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) is given a yellow card for dissent.
73' A yellow card for bad language! Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
73' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
73' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
72' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sends a rebound goalwards, low to the left-hand post, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it.
67' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Luka Modric (Real Madrid) replaces Rodrygo.
66' Jose Bordalas Jimenez is forced to make a change. Christantus Uche (Getafe) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by John Joe Patrick Finn.
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Alex Sola (Getafe) is replacing Carles Perez.
64' Real Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
63' 73:27 – the latest ball possession ratio.
59' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
58' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
57' Christantus Uche (Getafe) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
56' Christantus Uche (Getafe) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Christantus Uche (Getafe) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box. His attempt simply rattles the right post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.

55' Carles Perez (Getafe) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Thibaut Courtois thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
55' The ball is cleared after Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Alejandro Hernandez changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
50' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
49' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. PENALTY! One of the players from Real Madrid is about to take a penalty kick.
47' Luis Milla (Getafe) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
46' The game is over for Mauro Arambarri. Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Jose Bordalas Jimenez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Allan Nyom (Getafe). He is replaced by Christantus Uche.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is replaced by Arda Guler.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' It seemed like Luis Milla (Getafe) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45+2' What was Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
42' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
41' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar.

38' 2 - 0 Jude Bellingham produces a killer pass to release Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), who then unleashes a low drive from the edge of the box and scores! The ball goes in off the right post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 2:0!
35' Carles Perez (Getafe) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
32' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sends an accurate pass to Kylian Mbappe, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
30' 1 - 0 Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for David Soria to move before slotting the ball low into the middle of the goal!
30' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is going to take the penalty!
29' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
29' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
27' Allan Nyom (Getafe) brings an opponent down and Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game. A penalty is awarded to Real Madrid!
27' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
25' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

22' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Thibaut Courtois!
21' Luis Milla (Getafe) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
18' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles of the left post. Nice run, but poor finish!
15' The corner from Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is hurriedly cleared.
14' It seemed like Rodrygo (Real Madrid) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
12' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
11' Yellow card! It's like Allan Nyom (Getafe) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Alejandro Hernandez agrees and books him.
10' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
10' Omar Alderete (Getafe) plays a through ball but overhits it.
8' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
5' Allan Nyom (Getafe) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar.
4' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Getafe will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
